versions.changelog:
- Initial public release of the referral-program skill.
- Provides expert guidance on creating, optimizing, and analyzing referral, affiliate, and word-of-mouth programs.
- Includes frameworks for program design, incentive structures, optimization tactics, and success measurement.
- Features launch checklists, sample email sequences, and tool/platform recommendations.
- Covers both customer referral and affiliate program strategies, including when to use each.
